title: The New Rules of Media | Marc Andreessen & Ben Horowitz

thesis: The speakers argue that the media landscape has shifted from a defense-oriented model reliant on restricted channels and gatekeepers to an offense-oriented model where the brand is the person and formats are unlimited. They contend that founders must abandon the instinct to be media-trained or to avoid controversy, instead adopting an authentic, conversational style that speaks directly to audiences about topics they know intimately.
